mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `payment` WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM `payment` WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `payment` (order_id, order_no, pay_type, amount, qr_payload, status) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{payType}, #{amount}, #{qrPayload}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE `payment` SET status = 2 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE `payment` SET status = 3, raw_response = #{rawResponse} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
